text:
The volume of a gas in a sealed syringe is increased. The temperature of the gas does not
change.
before change
after change
After this change is made, what has happened to the gas molecules in the syringe?
A
They move more quickly.
B
They move more slowly.
C
They hit the syringe walls less often.
D
They hit the syringe walls more often.

options.label: C
options.text: They hit the syringe walls less often.

options.label: D
options.text: They hit the syringe walls more often.
